d.t: Self-smooting, medium duty, matt polyurethane cement hybrid flooring system
d.s: Sikafloor PurCem HS-24 system is made with polyurethane cement technology and is part of the Sikafloor PurCem flooring range. The Sikafloor PurCem HS-24 system is especially designed to withstand chemical attacks, high impacts and can be used in wet and dry processing plants. The system consists of a highly durable polyurethane cement body coat, it has an aesthetic, easy to clean and smooth surface, providing medium slip resistance. Is typically installed at 4 to 6 mm thick.
a: High chemical resistance. Resists a wide range of organic and inorganic acids, alkalis, amines, salts and solvents
Tolerant to moisture in the substrate

sec.t: Conformity with LEED v2009 IEQc 4.2: Low-Emitting Materials - Paints and Coatings

Screed material for floor screeds according to EN 13813:2002, Declaration of Performance 02 08 02 02 001 0 000017 1088, certified by notified factory production control body 0086, certificate of conformity of factory production control 541325, and provided with the CE-mark. Surface protection coating for concrete according to EN 1504-2:2004, Declaration of Performance 02 08 02 02 001 0 000017 1088, certified by notified factory production control body 0086, certificate of conformity of factory production control 541325, and provided with the CE-mark. Slip resistance properties according to DIN 51130 tested at MPI (Materialprüfung und Entwicklung), test reports refs. Nº 12-6638-S/12, dated August 7th, 2012.
